sql: select 'fill' k, f.kalshi_fill_id id, f.kalshi_order_id oid, f.side, f.action, f.price, f.quantity, f.fee, f.filled_at::text ts, lo.status, lo.quantity oq, lo.created_at::text oca, left(f.raw_fill_json::text, 300) raw from fills f left join live_orders lo on lo.kalshi_order_id = f.kalshi_order_id where f.market_ticker = 'KXRAIN-26OCT13-MIN' union all select 'pos', id::text, null, side, null, null, quantity, null, captured_at::text, null, null, null, left(raw_json::text, 400) from positions where market_ticker in ('KXRAIN-26OCT13-MIN','KXT20MATCH-26OCT112115MDVHKG-MDV','KXLALIGATOTAL-26SEP16LEVATH-6') and quantity = 0 order by 1, 9
